جَوَارٌ : see 3. ＝
-A2- Also The part of the exterior court or yard of a house that is coextensive with the house. (K, * TA.) ＝
-A3- Abundant and deep water. (K.) Whence ↓ جِوَرٌّ applied to rain. (TA.) ＝
-A4- Ships: a dial. var. of جَوَارٍ; on the authority of Sá'id, (K,) surnamed Abu-l-'Alà: (TA:) said in the K to be strange; but similar instances are well known. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
